Subject: Certification gateway & evidence lifecycle — initial scope questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro call last week. As Acme Bank starts our vendor certification cycle, the audit team asked us to gather some clarity on Redwood's planned cadence for ISO 27001 and FedRAMP readiness. A few specific asks to help scope our intake: 

- Can you confirm the target ISO 27001 certification quarter and whether Redwood intends to pursue FedRAMP Moderate in parallel or as a follow-on?
- For SIG / CAIQ intake: do you have a canonical questionnaire you prefer we return, or should we upload answers to Nexus Audit (cc'd)?
- Evidence sampling: what snapshot windows (logs, backups, config exports) can you provide for auditors, and who will be the primary point of contact for KMS and network boundary attestations?
- Any blackout or maintenance windows planned in Q3 that would affect an auditor's ability to access artifacts?

We're trying to map the mutual action plan and confirm whether Acme will need a dedicated evidence package or can consume standardized bundles. If you have a short checklist or timeline, we'd appreciate it.

Attached: (we will share a standard auditor intake template on our side)

Best,
Lisa Chen
Director, Vendor Risk & Audit
Acme Bank

Hi Lisa — thanks for the clear list. Below is a concise answer set and a proposed MAP (mutual action plan). Happy to hop on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Quick answers:
- ISO 27001: Targeted certification window: Q4 2028 (audit window October). We are running the controls sprint now and expect the Statement of Applicability (SoA) freeze by 2028-09-15.
- FedRAMP: We plan to pursue a FedRAMP Moderate assessment in H1 2029; initial readiness work (scoping, CSP-archive packaging) runs in parallel to ISO control stabilization. We will not gate ISO on FedRAMP but will align artifacts where possible.
- SIG / CAIQ: Please return the standard SIG/CAIQ PDF we attached (SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf). Nexus Audit can ingest it; both options are fine.
- Evidence sampling: We can provide 90-day log snapshots, weekly config exports, and encrypted backup manifests. KMS key access patterns and key-rotation evidence are held by our Security Engineering team — primary contact: kimberly.park@redwood.example.com.
- Maintenance windows: We have a quarterly infra maintenance blackout of 2 hours (second Tuesday of each quarter, 03:00–05:00 UTC) — it does not impede artifact access but can affect live console demos.

Proposed mutual action plan (high level):
1) Week of 2028-06-20: intake of SIG/CAIQ from Acme + Nexus (Lisa) — intake owner: Marissa.
2) Week of 2028-06-27: Redwood to provide evidence inventory and two sample artifacts for each control family (logs, config, policies) — owner: Compliance team (Marissa/Kimberly).
3) 2028-07-10: Dry-run of auditor access (Nexus) to sample bucket and read-only logs — owner: Infra ops (Rishi).
4) 2028-09-15: SoA freeze and evidence bucket finalized.
5) Q4 2028: ISO external audit window.

Attachments: SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf (we've annotated it with control groups we expect to own vs. need client confirmation). Also attaching a short sprint_scope workbook to map owners.

Next steps: if you can share Acme's priority control families or any auditor-specific checklist, we'll prioritize those artifacts first. I suggest a 30-minute intake call on Monday 2028-06-20 at 10:00 PT — does that work for you?

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Head of Compliance | Redwood Inference

2) Auditor dry-run: Rishi, please provision a read-only S3 bucket with 90-day log snapshots and a temporary auditor role (Nexus Audit). Document steps for access and expected TTL for keys. Target: 2028-07-07 (dry-run 07/10).

3) SIG/CAIQ annotation: Priyom, please review SIG_questionnaire_v2.pdf and add brief notes on any controls that currently lack evidence or need engineering work (estimate level: trivial/medium/high). Target: 2028-06-24.

I'll coordinate the intake call with Acme (tentatively 2028-06-20 10:00 PT). Please reply with any schedule conflicts.

Thanks — Marissa
